about: Every port a viewer's browser connects to, by address family and mode. The only declaration: the host agent allocates from it (src/fleet/agent/ports.rs), the viewer-path smoke checks each published URL against it (fleet/coord/stage-smoke.py), and ejc3/aws derives the GPU hosts' security group range from it. A GPU host publishes on its one public IPv4 address at gpu_host_ipv4.base (the agent's --tls-publish-base) plus the place's offset in its mode's range plus its index there.

ranges.what: a GPU slot: a wall renderer or a phone, by its GPU's index in the host's inventory
a Windows sandbox's bridge, by the sandbox's index on its host
a Minecraft server's view socket, by the server's index on its host
